topics.title: Identify and interpret explicit and implicit information and attitudes

subtopics.title: Identify and interpret explicit and implicit information and attitudes

outcomes.text: Understand both stated and implied meanings, attitudes and viewpoints in texts.
Study fiction, non-fiction, essays, reviews, articles and other genres as preparation for assessment.

topics.title: Demonstrate understanding of how writers use language and structure to achieve effects and influence

subtopics.title: Demonstrate understanding of how writers use language and structure to achieve effects and influence

outcomes.text: Identify and explain how writers use language, form and structure to create effects.
Examine writers’ language and style, including how facts, ideas, perspectives, opinions and bias influence readers.

topics.title: Analyse, evaluate and develop facts, ideas and opinions

subtopics.title: Analyse, evaluate and develop facts, ideas and opinions

outcomes.text: Give thoughtful, relevant responses to facts, ideas and opinions presented in texts.

topics.title: Select and synthesise information for specific purposes

subtopics.title: Select and synthesise information for specific purposes

outcomes.text: Accurately select ideas, information and features from texts and develop them for a stated purpose.
Develop skills in comparing, summarising and changing perspective when working with texts.
Organise writing so the sequence and development of ideas are clear to the reader.
Practise summarising in letters, reports, newspaper reports, magazine articles, journals and speeches.
Create discursive or argumentative letters and articles, as well as descriptive or narrative compositions.
Produce coherent writing that communicates effectively and keeps the reader interested.

topics.title: Use a range of appropriate vocabulary

subtopics.title: Use a range of appropriate vocabulary

outcomes.text: Select vocabulary that creates suitable effects for the purpose and intended audience.

topics.title: Use tone, style and register appropriate to audience and context

subtopics.title: Use tone, style and register appropriate to audience and context

outcomes.text: Use forms and styles that suit the purpose and audience.

topics.title: Make accurate use of spelling, punctuation and grammar

subtopics.title: Make accurate use of spelling, punctuation and grammar

outcomes.text: Write controlled paragraphs using varied sentences, accurate spelling and punctuation, and grammatically correct syntax.
